_comments: OFFBOARDING (golive #297). Its own file for the same coordination reason as `.sales-forecast-actions.json`:
MetadataSync reads every dot-json here, so separate files do not conflict.
Both Actions sit in common's "Offboarding Holdings" category; common's Offboarding screen runs every active
Action in it, so this app needs no compile-time link to common's screen. The category lookup resolves only
once a common release carrying that category is installed.

fields.Name: Sales: List Offboarding Holdings
fields.Description: List the open sales responsibility a departed user holds: open deals they own, their seats on open deal teams, the sales accounts and contacts they own, and pipelines whose close-won tasks go to them. Closed deals and history are not listed. Each row says whether the caller (the leaver's supervisor or a Sales Admin) may reassign it.
fields.UserPrompt: List the sales items a departed user still holds.

fields.Name: LeaverUserID
fields.Description: The departed user's MJ User ID. Give this, LeaverEmployeeID, or both; the other is resolved through MJ: Users.EmployeeID.

fields.Name: LeaverEmployeeID
fields.Description: The departed user's MJ Employee ID. Give this, LeaverUserID, or both.

fields.Name: Holdings
fields.Description: JSON array of holdings: App, Domain, Kind, KindLabel, EntityName, RecordID, Label, CanReassign, Note.

_comments: OFFBOARDING (golive #297). See the List action above for the category note.
Saves run as the caller, one record at a time, through each entity's own Save, so the deal's owner stamp,
team-role rules and entity permissions apply. A refused save is reported in Skipped, never bypassed.

fields.Name: Sales: Reassign Offboarding Holdings
fields.Description: Move a departed user's open sales responsibility to a successor: deal ownership, deal team seats, sales account and contact ownership, and pipeline close-won assignee. Only the leaver's supervisor or a Sales Admin may move them; the server re-checks this per item. History is never rewritten. Refusals are reported in Skipped.
fields.UserPrompt: Move a departed user's sales items to their successor.

fields.Name: LeaverUserID
fields.Description: The departed user's MJ User ID. Give this, LeaverEmployeeID, or both; the other is resolved through MJ: Users.EmployeeID.

fields.Name: LeaverEmployeeID
fields.Description: The departed user's MJ Employee ID. Give this, LeaverUserID, or both.

fields.Name: SuccessorUserID
fields.Description: The MJ User ID of the successor. Must be active and not the leaver; deal, account and contact items need the successor to have an Employee.

fields.Name: Kinds
fields.Description: Optional JSON array of Kind codes to move (DEAL_OWNER, DEAL_TEAM_MEMBER, ACCOUNT_OWNER, CONTACT_OWNER, PIPELINE_CLOSE_WON_ASSIGNEE). Empty means all.

fields.Name: RecordIDs
fields.Description: Optional JSON array of record IDs to move. Empty means all.

fields.Name: Skipped
fields.Description: JSON array of items not moved: Kind, EntityName, RecordID, Reason.
